headline: Red main cleared again — the storm ship waits one green nightly
lede: The nightly that #3193 fixed went red on one new thing: a stale FloorBoss watch-pin, broken silently when #2987 renamed the code it quotes. Slot b re-pinned it with all three honesty links, proved it fails on a mutant lie, and shipped the fix as #3209. A green nightly at 344f443 releases the freeze — and TIDAL RUSH rain-as-gameplay (#3194, green at the gate) lands the moment it does.

notes.text: Nightly 45482317911 failed full-smoke 908/909 — the lone red was a deterministic source pin quoting FloorBoss's pre-#2987 watch branch (now brainOn-shaped). Reproduced locally in Node, not a flake; re-pinned to bind brainOn → pad → recordTick so a lying autopilot still goes red.

Mutant proof: swap the watch feed to a human-shaped pad and the pin fires; restore and it passes. Shipped as PR #3209 under the red-main-fix precedent (#2176/#2957) — the freeze exists to hold everything except the fix that clears it.
Week pattern: each red-main clear exposes the next family (roster → dvh → mergecheck → panes → stale pins). If the dispatched nightly finds a new one, rule 5a ships the harness fix without waiting.
#3191 stays building by design: TIDAL RUSH rain-as-gameplay is fully built and green at the gate (PR #3194) — it merges the moment main-ok prints green, no re-runs needed.
